skills.name: component-portability
skills.description: Keep components self-contained and portable — a component folder's JS/TS + SCSS must work standalone when copied to another project.

skills.name: quality-gates
skills.description: The verification pipeline, hook wiring, and the hard prohibition on deploying without explicit user approval.

skills.name: styling-governance
skills.description: SCSS layering rules — CSS custom properties in components, token ownership, grid breakpoints, and shared vs component styles.

skills.name: testing-conventions
skills.description: Test layout, JavaScript-on-purpose policy, 100% per-file coverage, coverage-tail organization, and istanbul/resetModules pitfalls.

skills.name: zero-hardcoding
skills.description: Enforce the project's zero-hardcoding rule — every color, dimension, radius, class name, event, attribute, and string comes from token modules, never literals.

skills.name: perf-measure-protocol
skills.description: Measure-first performance protocol — how to detect and quantify gaps (Lighthouse, traces, scroll-fps) without changing behavior. Every perf change must be backed by a measured delta, never by intuition.

skills.name: perf-network-delivery
skills.description: Network-layer performance — critical-path depth, lazy/deferred code delivery, per-route chunking, preconnect hints, cache TTLs, and squeezing maximum throughput out of Firebase Hosting + Google Cloud Storage.

skills.name: perf-main-thread-layout
skills.description: Main-thread and layout performance — eliminating forced reflows and layout thrash, keeping tasks under budget, IntersectionObserver-first visibility, composited-only animations, and CLS discipline.

skills.name: perf-compute-offload
skills.description: Off-main-thread compute — WASM worker pool for batch CPU work, worker threads, GPU/WebGPU/WebGL/NPU paths, and keeping the main thread free for input and paint.
